gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-momo-trust-sans: Momo Trust Sans keeps its round letters open and friendly, bowls as heavy as the stems. Momo Trust Sans is the plain sans that lets Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe-wide c, do all the showing off.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mona-sans: Commanding and a little theatrical, Cherry Swash draws every stroke at one thickness, while Mona Sans below it stays plain sans and wide open. Pick a heading size well above the body.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-monda: Approachable is the first word for Monda, but Cherry Swash walks in first, loud and distinctive, with a horseshoe c. Monda then does the quiet work, a plain sans whose small counters never clog.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-mooli: A horseshoe-wide c gives Cherry Swash its swagger, every stroke traced at the width of one stylus. Mooli, a sans with open round letters, stays clear at small sizes, so a modest body size works.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-murecho: Modern and clean, Murecho speaks softly. Cherry Swash is best at making a loud, unit-width entrance with that horseshoe c, while Murecho's sans-serif s curves open wide and do the patient talking.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-nanum-gothic: Nanum Gothic leads with wide channels into every counter, a professional, contemporary build. Nanum Gothic does the steady explaining, while Cherry Swash handles the announcing, its bowls and stems drawn at matching weight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-national-park: Chunky display swagger meets rounded sans-serif. Cherry Swash's horseshoe c and heavy diagonals set the tone, then National Park, drawn with a pen that never shifts pressure, carries a longer read with a clearly open side on every round letter.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-canadia: Contemporary in feel, this pairing sets Cherry Swash's marker-traced, horseshoe-c heading against something quieter. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal brings sans-serif openness at every curve end, and that gap in weight is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Loud heading, soft landing. Noto Sans Cypriot, a sans-serif whose e opens up rather than closing its eye, makes a longer read feel easy after Cherry Swash's single-depth, engraver-cut display lines.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-cypro-m: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap. Cherry Swash, with its horseshoe c and thickness that ignores direction, takes the heading while this sans handles the text beneath.
